subject: Security questionnaire engagement + privacy/dataflow clarification
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@mediprime.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@mediprime.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: security questionnaire & privacy/dataflow items (next steps)

Hi Liam / Sara —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your compliance team what they need without extra back-and-forth: 

1) Controls posture: we confirmed Redwood has an in-progress SOC 2 Type II audit (expected close Q1 2027). I attached a one-page SOC2 summary for your initial review.

2) Privacy/regulatory scope: you mentioned GDPR + US healthcare considerations. For HIPAA concerns we support both private deployment options and data residency controls; we will surface the specific hosting/residency options in the evidence bundle.

3) Questionnaire selection: please confirm if you want the SIG (standard), CAIQ, or a custom vendor form. We typically prefill the SIG first (fastest) and can map answers to a CAIQ if you need cloud-specific detail.

4) Dataflow and evidence owners: to reduce friction, can you send a simple dataflow diagram (attachment or link) and point to 1–2 evidence owners on your side (e.g., security engineer + procurement contact)? We will use those owners for follow-up on items like encryption keys, access lists, and infra diagrams.

5) Timeline & priority: what target date does your security review need final answers by? We can prioritize a prefill + curated evidence bundle within 7 business days once the dataflow and owners are provided.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf, Redwood_SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (blank prefill we fill out), and a sample Evidence Checklist (in the SIG file).

Proposed next step: if you confirm SIG and share the dataflow + owner emails, I’ll schedule a 30-min SOC/sig kickoff with our security ops and Kimberly (technical onboarding) next week.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this fast.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com | (415) 555-0197

On Fri, 13 Nov 2026 at 14:18, Redwood Meeting Notes wrote:
> Call notes: MediPrime discovery — discussed inference workload patterns (bursty peak 10–15 TPS), model types (open LLM + fine-tuning), need for private deployment for PHI.

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@mediprime.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@mediprime.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security questionnaire & privacy/dataflow items (next steps)

Thanks Nikhil — nice summary. A few quick answers: 

- Questionnaire: SIG preferred. Our Security team likes the SIG matrix and your prefill approach.
- SOC2: we understand you’re in-flight; any interim artifacts (SOC2 test plan, PI-coverage summary) would be helpful — the PDF you attached looks good as a start.
- Dataflow: attaching an internal dataflow diagram (MediPrime_DataFlow_v3.png). That shows where PHI intersects with our LLM inference calls (we mark the entry/exit points).
- Evidence owners: please coordinate with Sara Patel (cc’d) for security engineering evidence, and I’ll handle procurement/contract items. Sara's preferred email for evidence requests is sara.patel@mediprime.com.
- Timeline: we’re aiming to complete vendor security validation by Dec 15, 2026. If you can get a prefill and evidence list in ~7 business days, that fits our schedule.

Questions for you: 
1) Does Redwood require access to any of our environments to collect logs or evidence, or do you accept uploaded artifacts only?
2) For SIG prefill, can you mark items as 'partial' if the audit is mid-flight, and provide a remediation/target-date field?

Attaching: MediPrime_DataFlow_v3.png

-Liam
Director of Security, MediPrime
liam.oconnor@mediprime.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@mediprime.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@mediprime.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: security questionnaire & privacy/dataflow items (next steps)

Liam / Sara — thanks for the quick reply and the dataflow. Helpful. A couple clarifications and next actions from our side: 

1) Evidence collection: we do not require live access to your environments. Uploaded artifacts (PDFs, screenshots, export CSVs) are fine and preferred. If you prefer, our Security Ops can receive artifacts via a secure hub (we will share a short S3 upload link or a Drive folder).

2) Partial answers: yes — we will mark SIG answers as 'partial' for items covered by the in-flight SOC2 and add a short note + expected completion (e.g., SOC2 completion Q1 2027). We include a remediation/target-date column in the prefill.

3) Owner contacts: Sara — can you confirm the best point-of-contact for evidence uploads (email + Slack handle if available)? We’ll send a scoped evidence checklist tied to the SIG rows to reduce noise.

4) Next steps / timeline: I’ll have Kimberly draft the SIG prefill and an Evidence Checklist tomorrow and share a Drive folder link (read-only + upload token). If MediPrime can confirm Sara as the owner and we get the dataflow already attached, we’ll target to deliver the prefill by Nov 23, which is within your 7-business-day window.

5) Proposed kickoff: Tue Nov 16, 10–10:30am PT for a quick alignment session (security owners + Redwood sec ops + Kimberly). Please confirm availability or propose an alternative.

Links / attachments we will share: Redwood_SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (pre-populated answers + partial flags), evidence checklist (CSV), shared Drive folder (upload instructions).

Thanks — we’ll keep this tight.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com | (415) 555-0197

--
Nikhil Sharma
